name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
summary: Deposit-free LPG connection for women from deprived households, with the first refill and stove free.
description: Deposit-free LPG connection for adult women from deprived households, introduced by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas in May 2016.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

evidence.quote: Adult woman belonging to any of the following categories.
Applicant must have attained 18 years of age.

criteria.label: Household belongs to one of the listed categories (SC/ST households, PMAY-G, Most Backward Classes, AAY, tea garden tribes, forest dwellers, island residents, SECC households, or poor household as per 14-point declaration)
No other LPG connection in the same household

evidence.quote: There should not be any other LPG connections in the same household.

benefits.text: Cash assistance of Rs. 1600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder connection (Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder), covering security deposit, regulator, hose, consumer card and installation charges.

evidence.quote: Cash assistance for PMUY connections is provided by Government of India - Rs. 1600 (for a connection 14.2kg cylinder/ Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder).

benefits.text: First LPG refill and stove (hotplate) free of cost, with the deposit-free connection.

evidence.quote: Additionally, All PMUY beneficiaries will be provided with first LPG refill and Stove (hotplate) both free of cost along with their deposit free connection by the Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs).

documents.name: Ration card or other State Government document certifying family composition (self-declaration for migrants)

evidence.quote: Ration Card issued by the State from which application is being made/ other State Govt. document certifying family composition/ Self-Declaration as per Annexure I (for migrant applicants)

documents.name: Aadhaar of beneficiary and adult family members

evidence.quote: Aadhaar of beneficiary and adult family members appearing in document at Sl. 2

applicationProcess: Apply online through the PMUY portal ('Apply for New PMUY Connection'), or submit the KYC form and documents at the nearest LPG distributor.
